questions.explanation_pinyin: “liǎng bēi shuǐ” shǐ yòng “liǎng” biǎo shì shù liàng èr, “bēi” zuò wéi yǐn liào de liàng cí, “shuǐ” shì bèi liàng dù de yǐn liào.
questions.explanation_translation: 两 indicates two, 杯 is the measure word for a cup of drink, and 水 is the beverage being measured.

questions.prompt_learning: Which Chinese question asks “Have you ever eaten Beijing duck”?
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the most natural Simplified Chinese equivalent.

options.pinyin: nǐ chī zhe běi jīng kǎo yā ma
nǐ chī guo běi jīng kǎo yā ma
options.learning_text: Have you ever eaten Beijing duck?

options.pinyin: nǐ gāng cái chī le běi jīng kǎo yā ma
options.learning_text: Did you eat Beijing duck just now?
options.translation_text: 你刚才吃了北京烤鸭吗？

options.pinyin: nǐ xǐ huan běi jīng kǎo yā ma

questions.explanation_learning: 动词后的“过”表示曾经有过某种经历；句末“吗”把句子变成是非疑问句。
questions.explanation_pinyin: dòng cí hòu de “guo” biǎo shì céng jīng yǒu guò mǒu zhǒng jīng lì; jù mò “ma” bǎ jù zi biàn chéng shì fǒu yí wèn jù.
questions.explanation_translation: 过 after a verb asks about prior experience. The final 吗 turns the sentence into a yes/no question.

questions.prompt_learning: Which sentence means “She has already arrived”?
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the most natural Simplified Chinese equivalent.
questions.explanation_learning: “已经”表示某件事到现在为止已经发生，“到了”说明到达这一动作已经实现。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yǐ jīng” biǎo shì mǒu jiàn shì dào xiàn zài wéi zhǐ yǐ jīng fā shēng, “dào le” shuō míng dào dá zhè yí dòng zuò yǐ jīng shí xiàn.
questions.explanation_translation: 已经 means “already,” and 到了 indicates that the arrival has happened.

questions.prompt_learning: Which sentence means “This book is more interesting than that one”?
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the most natural Simplified Chinese equivalent.

options.pinyin: zhè běn shū hé nà běn yí yàng yǒu yì si
options.learning_text: This book is as interesting as that one.
options.translation_text: 这本书和那本一样有意思。

options.pinyin: nà běn shū bǐ zhè běn gèng yǒu yì si
options.learning_text: That book is more interesting than this one.
options.translation_text: 那本书比这本更有意思。

options.pinyin: zhè běn shū bǐ nà běn gèng yǒu yì si
options.learning_text: This book is more interesting than that one.
options.translation_text: 这本书比那本更有意思。

options.pinyin: zhè běn shū méi yǒu nà běn yǒu yì si
options.learning_text: This book is not as interesting as that one.
options.translation_text: 这本书没有那本有意思。

questions.explanation_learning: “A比B更有意思”表示A比B更有趣；“更”加强比较程度。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “A bǐ B gèng yǒu yì si” biǎo shì A bǐ B gèng yǒu qù; “gèng” jiā qiáng bǐ jiào chéng dù.
questions.explanation_translation: A比B更有意思 says that A is more interesting than B. 更 strengthens the comparison.

questions.prompt_learning: Which sentence means “Because it was raining, I stayed at home”?
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the most natural Simplified Chinese equivalent.

options.pinyin: suī rán xià yǔ, dàn shì wǒ dāi zài jiā lǐ
options.learning_text: Although it was raining, I stayed at home.
options.translation_text: 虽然下雨，但是我待在家里。

options.pinyin: rú guǒ xià yǔ, wǒ jiù dāi zài jiā lǐ
options.learning_text: If it rains, I will stay at home.
options.translation_text: 如果下雨，我就待在家里。

options.pinyin: yīn wèi wǒ dāi zài jiā lǐ, suǒ yǐ kāi shǐ xià yǔ
options.learning_text: Because I stayed at home, it started raining.
options.translation_text: 因为我待在家里，所以开始下雨。

options.pinyin: yīn wèi xià yǔ, suǒ yǐ wǒ dāi zài jiā lǐ
options.learning_text: Because it was raining, I stayed at home.
options.translation_text: 因为下雨，所以我待在家里。

questions.explanation_learning: “因为”引出下雨这一原因，“所以”引出待在家里的结果，形成因果关系。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yīn wèi” yǐn chū xià yǔ zhè yí yuán yīn, “suǒ yǐ” yǐn chū dāi zài jiā lǐ de jié guǒ, xíng chéng yīn guǒ guān xì.
questions.explanation_translation: 因为 introduces the reason (the rain), and 所以 introduces the result (staying at home), forming a cause-and-effect relationship.

questions.prompt_learning: Which sentence means “Please put the book on the table”?
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the most natural Simplified Chinese equivalent.

options.pinyin: qǐng bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
options.learning_text: Please put the book on the table.

options.pinyin: qǐng bǎ zhuō zi fàng zài shū shàng
options.learning_text: Please put the table on the book.

options.pinyin: qǐng bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi xià miàn
options.learning_text: Please put the book under the table.

options.pinyin: shū zài zhuō zi shàng, qǐng
options.learning_text: The book is on the table, please.

questions.explanation_learning: “把”提前说明被处理的物品，“放在桌子上”说明书被放置的位置。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “bǎ” tí qián shuō míng bèi chǔ lǐ de wù pǐn, “fàng zài zhuō zi shàng” shuō míng shū bèi fàng zhì de wèi zhì.
questions.explanation_translation: 把 introduces the object being handled, while 放在桌子上 states where the book should be placed.

questions.prompt_learning: Which sentence means “The task was difficult; nevertheless, she completed it”?
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the most natural Simplified Chinese equivalent.

options.pinyin: rèn wù hěn nán, yīn cǐ tā wán chéng le
options.learning_text: The task was difficult; therefore, she completed it.
options.translation_text: 任务很难，因此她完成了。

options.pinyin: rèn wù hěn nán, cǐ wài tā wán chéng le
options.learning_text: The task was difficult; in addition, she completed it.
options.translation_text: 任务很难，此外她完成了。

options.pinyin: rèn wù hěn nán, rán ér tā hái shì wán chéng le
options.learning_text: The task was difficult; nevertheless, she completed it.
options.translation_text: 任务很难，然而她还是完成了。

options.pinyin: rèn wù hěn nán, fǎn ér tā wán chéng le
options.learning_text: The task was difficult; instead, she completed it.
options.translation_text: 任务很难，反而她完成了。

questions.explanation_learning: “然而”引出与前面情况形成转折的结果；“还是”强调尽管困难，行动仍然发生。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “rán ér” yǐn chū yǔ qián miàn qíng kuàng xíng chéng zhuǎn zhé de jié guǒ; “hái shì” qiáng diào jǐn guǎn kùn nán, xíng dòng réng rán fā shēng.
questions.explanation_translation: 然而 introduces a contrast with the preceding difficulty. 还是 emphasises that she completed the task despite it.

questions.prompt_learning: Which idiom advises correcting a problem in time so that the loss does not continue?
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the most natural Simplified Chinese equivalent.

options.learning_text: Add unnecessary details and spoil the result.
Repair the situation after a loss to prevent further damage.
Achieve two things with one action.

questions.explanation_learning: “亡羊补牢”比喻出了问题后及时补救，避免损失继续扩大。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wáng yáng bǔ láo” bǐ yù chū le wèn tí hòu jí shí bǔ jiù, bì miǎn sǔn shī jì xù kuò dà.
questions.explanation_translation: 亡羊补牢 describes taking corrective action after a problem so that further loss can be prevented.

questions.prompt_learning: Which sentence means “He is especially interested in Chinese history”?
questions.prompt_translation: Choose the most natural Simplified Chinese equivalent.

options.pinyin: tā ǒu ěr duì zhōng guó lì shǐ gǎn xìng qù
options.learning_text: He is occasionally interested in Chinese history.
options.translation_text: 他偶尔对中国历史感兴趣。

options.pinyin: tā zhǐ duì zhōng guó lì shǐ gǎn xìng qù
options.learning_text: He is only interested in Chinese history.

options.pinyin: tā yǐ jīng duì zhōng guó lì shǐ gǎn xìng qù
options.learning_text: He is already interested in Chinese history.

options.learning_text: He is especially interested in Chinese history.

questions.explanation_learning: “尤其”用于突出某个人或事物，表示它比其他对象更值得注意。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yóu qí” yòng yú tū chū mǒu gè rén huò shì wù, biǎo shì tā bǐ qí tā duì xiàng gèng zhí dé zhù yì.
questions.explanation_translation: 尤其 highlights a person or thing as particularly noteworthy compared with others.

questions.explanation_learning: “辛苦了”用于认可他人的努力或辛劳；“大家”指所有人，“今天”指说话当天。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “xīn kǔ le” yòng yú rèn kě tā rén de nǔ lì huò xīn láo; “dà jiā” zhǐ suǒ yǒu rén, “jīn tiān” zhǐ shuō huà dāng tiān.
questions.explanation_translation: 辛苦了 acknowledges someone's effort or hard work. 大家 means everyone, and 今天 means today.
